svg.aria-label: A real 38-minute test ride: the fan's power reading lies on the bike computer's all the way (0.7 W apart on average), and the fan level steps up 0, 1, 2, 3 with the workout, is 3 in the hard intervals and 2 in the short rests, goes off about a minute after pedaling stops and comes back when riding resumes, and is at 1 in the cool-down
svg.text: Real ride, smart trainer in ERG, FTP 170 W. The bike computer lost the trainer for 10 short moments (30 s in all, 0 W while pedaling); they are left out of its line.
